_doc: Oracle bounds per SIGNAL family (kb/data/facts.md §11; kb/data/screens/CEILING.md), and which card draws on which signal. A bound is the most a family measured with information no legal model has (valid-week labels, split-half, the random log, the leaky statistics file) could add on the champion; null = no oracle exists, the card is judged by its record alone. Cards absent from `cards` are unbounded.

item-side.source: facts §11.2 row 'video / author side, any period': valid-week LOO video rate +0.0003, leaky month statistics +0.0000

day-state.source: facts §11.2 row 'user state that day': other-half user × date +0.0000; label-free day context ≤ +0.0002

random-log.source: facts §11.2 row 'random-exposure log': user-day / user-week / video-week ≤ +0.0001

user-context-taste.source: facts §11.2 row 'user × tab / duration / tag / type taste': other-half rates ≤ +0.0003

history-cf.source: facts §11.2 row 'train-history taste, item-kNN, repeats': ≤ +0.0002 each; history-user-aggregates measured 0 on BPR

creator-affinity.source: facts §11.2 row 'user × author, user × music': +0.0021 / +0.0016 with same-week labels at 3 % coverage — unobservable at scoring time; from train history ≤ +0.0001

recency-volume.source: facts §11.3: train + half of valid on the other half 0.5821 vs 0.5826; windows from 04-12 / 04-14 / 04-15 lose 0.003–0.008 — volume, not recency
